scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
We are busy as hell because of Bangungots servants attacking the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
噩梦死神般滚勾特的仆从正在袭击医院，我们忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
We are doing our best in securing the safety of our village so please enjoy your stay in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
我们正全力确保村子的安全，请安心在马来港逗留。

scripts.text: Tell him about Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 告诉他宝箱巨鳄的事

scripts.text: Done with conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya? The merciless creature is back?
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄？那个残暴的家伙又回来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That's bad news. We are already short-handed by assigning everyone to fight off Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
这可糟了。我们已经人手不足，所有人都派去抵挡噩梦死神般滚勾特了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
And villagers need to go to the woods to collect fruits and vegetables.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
而且村民还得去森林里采集蔬果。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hmm... will you be able to help Port Malaya?
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
嗯......你愿意帮帮马来港吗？

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交给我吧！

scripts.text: I'm pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己也忙得很。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Really? That's no good. All the lives of the villagers will be at stake if we don't do something. How can a youth like you be so heartless. Are all outsiders like you? Hmph! Can't trust young people these days. Hmph.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
真的吗？那可不行。我们要是不采取行动，村民的性命都会受到威胁。你年纪轻轻，怎么这么冷漠？外来者都像你这样吗？哼！现在的年轻人真不可靠。哼。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I knew I could count on you.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
我就知道能指望你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good. I will trust you.
I need to know where Buwaya will likely appear in order to secure villagers living area.
Guess Buwayas nest will be the best bet.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
很好，我相信你。
为了保护村民的住处，我得知道宝箱巨鳄可能会在哪里出没。
最好先找到它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
到达那一带后，^3131FF投掷烟雾弹^000000。
我们会朝烟雾升起的地方赶去。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Then take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
那就小心行事，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
到达那一带后，^3131FF投掷烟雾弹^000000。
我们会朝烟雾升起的地方赶去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's first bring Ed to Totoy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们先把艾德带回托托伊身边吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
The Guard Leader gave you the location of Buwaya's cave.
This can't be happening.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
卫队长把宝箱巨鳄洞穴的位置告诉了你。
这下可麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I'm way out of men to assign to the Buwaya situation but well have to do something with what we got.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
我手下已经抽不出人手来处理宝箱巨鳄了，不过只能靠现有的人力想办法。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Here, this is a symbol of our gratitude.
If you would like to help with Buwaya again, please look for me.
Hope you have a great journey.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
拿着，这是我们的一点谢意。
如果还愿意帮忙对付宝箱巨鳄，随时来找我。
祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hear Buwaya appeared from the depth of the Forest.
As everyone knows, all our manpower is dispatched to handle Bangungots servants attacking the hospital recently.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
听说宝箱巨鳄出现在森林深处。
大家都知道，最近我们的人手全派去应对袭击医院的噩梦死神般滚勾特仆从了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That is why we have no choice but to ask an outsider to help eliminate Buwaya.
They say Buwaya is a very strong and ugly monster with two heads.
Will you help us defeat Buwaya?
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
所以我们只能请外来者帮忙消灭宝箱巨鳄。
据说它是个强壮又丑陋的双头魔物。
你愿意帮我们打倒它吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然愿意。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄是出了名的危险。
拒绝这个请求也没什么可羞愧的。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
This mission will be a dangerous one.
If you want to help get rid of Buwaya, you must be prepared.
Come back once you reach LV 130.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
这次任务很危险。
想帮忙除掉宝箱巨鳄，就得做好准备。
达到130级后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
According to the legend, Buwaya kidnaps people and puts them in the sack on its back and then eats them later.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
传说宝箱巨鳄会绑架人，把他们塞进背上的囊袋里，之后再吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
记住这点，时刻保持警惕。
我建议你找几个可靠的同伴一起行动。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
How is it going with the Buwaya situation?
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄的事办得怎么样了？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃了。

scripts.text: Still fighting.
scripts.translation: 还在战斗。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
记住这点，时刻保持警惕。
我建议你找几个可靠的同伴一起行动。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄是出了名的危险。
拒绝这个请求也没什么可羞愧的。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Can't believe you really got rid of Buwaya!
You aren't just any ordinary youth, aren't you? People of Port Malaya can now sleep at night.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
真不敢相信你真的除掉了宝箱巨鳄！
你可不是普通的年轻人。现在马来港的居民终于能睡个安稳觉了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
干得好。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I will not stand down until all of Port Malaya, including Baryo Mahiwaga, is safe from Buwaya. Promise to take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[守卫队长]
在马来港和巴里奥·马希瓦加都摆脱宝箱巨鳄的威胁之前，我绝不会退下。你一定要保重。

scripts.text: Bark bark!!
scripts.translation: 汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why is a dog here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里怎么会有只狗？

scripts.text: Look closely at the dog.
scripts.translation: 仔细看看这只狗

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 不理它

[{0}]
Looks like a lost dog.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看起来像只走丢的狗。

scripts.translation: - 你仔细打量这只脏兮兮的狗，发现它脖子上戴着一条旧项圈。 -

scripts.text: - The collar says, 'Forever with Totoy'. -
scripts.translation: - 项圈上写着：“永远和托托伊在一起”。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you are Ed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来你就是艾德？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪！汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You didn't get killed by Buwaya. You lucky little dog. Let's go back to your owner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然没被宝箱巨鳄吃掉，真是命大。走吧，带你回主人身边。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, before we go, do you happen to know where Buwaya's nest is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，出发前问一下，你知道宝箱巨鳄的巢穴在哪儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪！

scripts.text: - Ed is one smart dog and understood what you asked him. Ed started to bark towards the north. -
scripts.translation: - 艾德真聪明，听懂了你的问题，开始朝北边叫。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Buwaya is over there!
Then I should shoot the smoke bomb here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
宝箱巨鳄在那边！
我应该就在这里发射烟雾弹。

scripts.text: - You take the smoke bomb out of your inventory and shoot towards the sky. -
scripts.translation: - 你从物品栏取出烟雾弹，朝天空发射。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Job well done!
So Buwaya lives in remote place like this. I will make sure this information goes to the Guard Leader!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
干得好！
原来宝箱巨鳄住在这么偏僻的地方。我会把这条消息报告给卫队长！

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lets first bring Ed to Totoy and then go back to the Guard Leader.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先把艾德送回托托伊那里，再去找卫队长吧。

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Story of dragon that lives at a lake~
Story of an old lady
that became a dragon long ago~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
湖中恶龙的故事~
还有一位老妇人
很久以前变成恶龙的故事~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Waiting for the son that left for a foreign land,
my son will return
when that moon sets for the 90th time
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
等待远赴异乡的儿子，
等月亮落下第九十次，
儿子就会回来

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The moon sets for the 89th,
The moon sets for the 90th,
The moon sets for the 191st...
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
月亮落下了第八十九次，
月亮落下了第九十次，
月亮落下了第一百九十一次......

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
That moon has taken my son away~
That horrible thing
has swallowed my son,
and I will punish that moon~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
那轮月亮夺走了我的儿子~
那可怕的东西
吞掉了我的儿子，
我要惩罚那轮月亮~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The day the furious moon hides itself from sight,
the whole world will be flooded with rain
with all the villages and people facing death under water~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
愤怒的月亮隐去的那天，
暴雨将淹没整个世界，
村庄和人们都将葬身水底~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The old lady's curse made the moon furious~
Get rid of the old lady to calm the moon~
If only the old lady wasn't here, If only the old lady wasn't here...
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
老妇人的诅咒激怒了月亮~
赶走老妇人，平息月亮的怒火~
要是老妇人不在就好了，要是她不在就好了......

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
I hear rumors~
The old lady threw herself into the lake~
the old lady, now turned into a dragon, will swallow the moon
and soon swallow the village too~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
我听说啊~
老妇人跳进了湖里~
她如今变成恶龙，
要吞掉月亮，很快也会吞掉村庄~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
You say the legend is all a lie?
You mean my ancestors are all liars
and swindlers?
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
你说传说全是假的？
你是说我的祖先都是骗子，
都是欺诈之徒？

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
This village is built on an old legend
and history.
They are not the kind of people that will be shaken by
foolish words of an imbecile such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
这座村庄建立在古老的传说
与历史之上。
我们可不会被你这种蠢货的
胡言乱语动摇。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Bakonawa that live at a lake,
story of an old lady that became a dragon.
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
住在湖里的巴库纳瓦，
还有老妇人变成恶龙的故事。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The son that was suppose to return after the moon sets for the 90th time
never did come back even after the moon had set for a few hundred times~
The moon has swallowed the old lady's son~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
那个本该在月亮落下第九十次时回来的儿子，
即使月亮落下了几百次，还是没有回来~
月亮吞掉了老妇人的儿子~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, you shall receive the old lady's curse~
The whole village was immersed in death
with rain and floods sent by the furious moon~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
月亮啊，月亮啊，你将承受老妇人的诅咒~
愤怒的月亮降下暴雨与洪水，
整个村庄都陷入死亡的深渊~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, be still and be calm,
for the old lady is gone and she is no more~
The old lady has drowned in the lake~
She will transform into Bakonawa and come back...
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
月亮啊，月亮啊，安静下来，平息怒火吧，
老妇人已经离去，不复存在~
老妇人淹死在湖里~
她将化作巴库纳瓦，重返人间......

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
...to swallow you and
punish the village soon~
The day the moon dies
is the day the village dies too~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
......把你吞下，
很快就会惩罚整个村庄~
月亮死去的那天，
也是村庄灭亡之日~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The legends are all a lie?
Why do you say such nonsense?
Is there nothing
that is important for you to protect?
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
传说全是谎言？
你为什么要说这种胡话？
难道你没有什么
想要守护的珍贵之物吗？

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Poor Bakonawa...
I would be happy
if she took a big bite out of someone like you!
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
可怜的巴库纳瓦......
要是它能狠狠咬你一口，
我倒会很高兴！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The vicious monster Bakonawa will soon come
to swallow the moon and take vengeance upon the village.
I'm scared, please help...
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的男孩]
可怕的魔物巴库纳瓦很快就要来了，
它要吞掉月亮，向村庄复仇。
我好害怕，请帮帮我......

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The legend of Bakonawa is all a lie?
So that means Bakonawa doesn't exist?
I'm going to play with my friends at the lake later.
You told me it was all a lie right?
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的男孩]
巴库纳瓦的传说都是假的？
那就是说巴库纳瓦根本不存在？
我等会儿要去湖边和朋友玩。
你刚才说那些都是假的，对吧？

scripts.text: - She seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is said that Bakonawa hates loud noises.
Pound the pot if you want to live!
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
据说巴库纳瓦讨厌巨响。
想活命就敲锅！

scripts.text: Hates loud noises?
scripts.translation: 它讨厌巨响？

scripts.text: What is Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 巴库纳瓦是什么？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
You already heard that the old lady
died and became Bakonawa, right?
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
你已经听说那位老妇人死后变成巴库纳瓦的事了吧？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The legend has it that
the old lady had very keen hearing
because she was always focusing on
the returning of her traveling son.
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
传说那位老妇人听力特别敏锐，
因为她总是专心等待
远行的儿子归来。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
So naturally, Bakonawa also
has very keen hearing.
The reason why everyone is banging
pots and pans is because of this.
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
所以巴库纳瓦自然也有
敏锐的听觉。
大家拼命敲打锅碗瓢盆，
就是因为这个。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is a terrible monster that lives at a lake.
We are all trembling with fear
because we don't know when it might attack the village.
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
它是栖息在湖中的可怕魔物。
我们都吓得发抖，
不知道它什么时候会袭击村庄。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
Some say that it is more obsessed with swallowing the moon
than attacking the village.
if that's the case, I wish it would just swallow the moon
and leave us alone.
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
有人说，比起袭击村庄，
它更执着于吞掉月亮。
如果真是这样，我倒希望它干脆吞了月亮，
然后别来烦我们。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The villagers hate you now.
You've been saying that legend of Bakonawa
is a lie and they are saying you are more of a monster
than Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的少女]
村民们现在都很讨厌你。
你一直说巴库纳瓦的传说是假的，
他们觉得你比巴库纳瓦更像魔物。

scripts.text: - Old Fortune Teller seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 年迈的占卜师似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
You must not hate Bakonawa.
The hate against it is only feeding its rage
to grow bigger.
scripts.translation:
[老占卜师]
你不该憎恨巴库纳瓦。
人们对它的憎恨只会助长它的怒火，
让怒火越烧越旺。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
To calm the dead lady's anger,
we annually hold a ceremony and prepare food.
But there seems to be no way to calm the
ever growing anger of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[老占卜师]
为了平息那位老妇人的怨恨，
我们每年都会举行仪式、准备供品。
可老妇人的怨恨似乎与日俱增，
我们已经找不到平息它的办法了。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
The day is nearing. I can sense it.
Bakonawa will soon swallow the moon
and come to punish the village.
scripts.translation:
[老占卜师]
那一天就快到了，我能感觉到。
巴库纳瓦很快就会吞掉月亮，
前来惩罚村庄。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
How can you say the legend is a lie!
Because of you, the fury of Bakonawa
grew even larger!
If the village perishes,
it is all your fault!
scripts.translation:
[老占卜师]
你怎么能说传说是假的！
都是因为你，巴库纳瓦的怒火
才变得更加强烈！
要是村庄毁灭了，
全都是你的错！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品过多，无法开始对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is something that needs to be done
but you look too fragile
to give me a hand.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
有件事非做不可，
可你看起来太弱了，
帮不了我。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Come back when
your strength grows strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
等你强到能和梦魇对抗时，
再回来吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady has come back
to life as Bakonawa.
Soon she will come to take vengeance on the village.
We must calm her
if to prevent further destruction...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
那位老妇人已经化作巴库纳瓦复活了。
她很快就会回来向村庄复仇。
为了避免更多破坏，
我们必须平息她的怒火......

scripts.text: Calm Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 平息巴库纳瓦的怒火？

scripts.text: Further destruction?
scripts.translation: 避免更多破坏？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady faced an unjust death
because of villagers' selfishness.
She was a caring mother who loved her
son dearly.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
那位老妇人因村民的自私而含冤死去。
她是一位慈爱的母亲，深爱着自己的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If we track the whereabouts of her son and hold a ritual
with her son's belongings,
her restless soul will be calmed
and she will spare us from destruction.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
如果我们查明她儿子的下落，
用他留下的遗物举行仪式，
就能安抚他母亲不安的灵魂，
让她不再毁坏村庄。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
It is no use sir!!
scripts.translation:
[村民们]
先生，没用的！！

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
You cannot stop the monster that way!
scripts.translation:
[村民们]
那样根本阻止不了魔物！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Of course, it will not be easy to track down the whereabouts of a person
who has been gone for a hundred years.
...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
当然，要追查一个失踪百年的人的下落，
绝非易事。
......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Still, don't you think
it is worth a try?
Please help us and save us from our misery.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
不过，你不觉得值得一试吗？
求你帮帮我们，救大家脱离苦难。

scripts.text: It is no use.
scripts.translation: 这没用的。

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Yes, you are also right.
You are up against not a human,
but a monster.
Still, I trust in that old lady's
good heart.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
是啊，你说得也有道理。
你要面对的不是人，而是魔物。
不过，我依然相信那位老妇人心底的善良。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Will you do it?
According to the legend,
the old lady's son was limping
and was a traveling merchant that sold wooden dolls.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
你愿意帮忙吗？
传说那位老妇人的儿子是个跛脚的旅行商人，
专门贩卖木偶。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is a ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000 he left.
But the piece is small and damaged,
its hard to identify it.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
他留下了一块^FF0000石板碎片^000000。
碎片又小又破损，
很难辨认。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
First, bring it to me.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
先把它带给我。
沿着这条路往下走，
你会在港口附近遇到我的孙女。
去找她拿石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The grudge against the people of
Bakonawa- I mean, the dead old lady.
The moon and this village...
She will try to destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
她对巴库纳瓦——我是说，对那位已故老妇人的怨恨。
对月亮和这座村庄的怨恨......
她想毁掉这一切。

scripts.text: Take vengeance? After all these years?
scripts.translation: 这么多年过去了，她还要复仇？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
For some time, she has
blamed the moon and
resented the villagers.
The feeling grew larger as the time passed.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
有一段时间，她一直责怪月亮，
也怨恨村民。
随着岁月流逝，这份怨恨愈发强烈。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why do you think she became such a monster?
What do you think went through her head
for years and years?
Anger and vengeance.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
你觉得她为何会变成这样的魔物？
你想想她这么多年来心里想着什么？
是愤怒，是复仇。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Unforgettable grudge
that she was abandoned.
against the moon and the village.
This is why this grudge must be resolved.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
她被抛弃后留下的刻骨怨恨，
指向月亮，也指向村庄。
所以我们必须化解这份怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Please bring the ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
请把^FF0000石板碎片^000000带来。
沿着这条路往下走，
你会在港口附近遇到我的孙女。
去找她拿石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Good, you have the Slate Piece.
Hold on to it and don't lose it.
It will be of helpful in tracking down the legend.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
很好，你拿到石板碎片了。
收好，别弄丢。
调查这段传说时会用得上。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I heard there is a man that lives by himself
at the end of northwestern part of Forest Field.
I heard someone saw a wooden doll there.
It is such a remote place that people like us
simply cannot travel there.
Could you visit the place for us?
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
我听说森林西北尽头住着一个独居的男人。
有人还说在那里见过木偶。
那个地方实在太偏远，我们这种人根本去不了。
你能替我们去看看吗？

scripts.text: Go there yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: Your explanation is too vague.
scripts.translation: 你说得也太含糊了。

scripts.text: On my way!
scripts.translation: 我这就去！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You twisted youth!
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
你这个不知好歹的小子！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a point, but
this is the best I can do for now.
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
你说得有道理，不过我现在只能告诉你这么多了。
那个地方在森林西北尽头。过桥后往西走，就能看到一个人。
祝你好运......为了我们......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a good heart young man!
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
You will see a ^0000FFMalaya Immigrant^000000.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
你真是个善良的年轻人！
那个地方在森林西北尽头。过桥后往西走，
你会看到一位^0000FF马来移民^000000。
祝你好运......为了我们......

scripts.text: Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation: 祝你好运......为了我们......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
那个地方在森林西北尽头。过桥后往西走，
你就会看到一个人。
祝你好运......为了我们......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The track of the old lady's son
is connected all the way to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
There is a chance he wasn't a merchant...
I'm really curious about who he was...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
老妇人的儿子的线索，
竟然一路指向
巴里奥·马希瓦加？
说不定他根本不是商人......
我真想知道他究竟是谁......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why did you come back here
instead of going straight to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
你为什么没直接去
巴里奥·马希瓦加，
反而回到这里来了？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Is that really true?
Bakonawa turning into an old lady
and fabricating the legend...
It seems all the villagers up until now
have been manipulated by that terrible monster.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
这是真的吗？
巴库暴龙变成老妇人，
还编造了那段传说......
看来这么多年来，村民们
一直被那只可怕的魔物蒙骗了。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is no reason to hesitate then.
You must go into Bakonawa's lair
before it attacks first.
I believe we can trust you to do this, yes?
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
既然如此，就没什么好犹豫的了。
你必须赶在巴库暴龙袭击之前，
进入它的巢穴。
这件事就拜托你了，好吗？

scripts.text: Well...
Of course!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The atmosphere was really good
but suddenly it's all ruined.
I didn't expect you to be so shy...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
气氛本来好好的，
突然全被你破坏了。
没想到你这么害羞......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I will speak to
the village chief for you
so that you can enter the Bakonawa Lake.
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
我会替你向村长说明，
让你进入巴库纳瓦湖。
请替我们除掉这只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If you don't mind,
could you lend a hand to the Village Chief?
Nobody cares for each other anymore
because of Bakonawa...
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
如果你不介意，
能帮村长一把吗？
巴库暴龙害得大家
都不再关心彼此了......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The legend that
we believed for a hundred years,
all lies....
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[老传说讲述者]
我们信了一百年的传说，
竟然全是谎言......
请替我们除掉这只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
你一定很勇敢，
才会来到这么偏远的地方。
最近马来港怎么样？
我听说湖里的魔物巴库暴龙
正在威胁村民。
我一直待在这里，对那边的情况不太了解。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
你一定很勇敢，
才会来到这么偏远的地方。
最近马来港怎么样？
我听说湖里的魔物巴库暴龙
正在威胁村民。
我一直待在这里，对那边的情况不太了解。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Are you the traveling merchant who used to sell Wooden Doll, right?
I don't know about any traveling merchant, but by Wooden Doll
(going through things) do you mean this?
I don't know about the specifics, but
I think it's related to what I heard long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
你是以前卖木偶的旅行商人吧？
我不认识什么旅行商人，不过你说的木偶......
（翻找东西）是这个吗？
具体情况我不太清楚，
但这让我想起很久以前听过的一件事。

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么住在这里？

scripts.text: Do you know about this Slate Piece?
scripts.translation: 你知道这块石板碎片的事吗？

scripts.text: Please tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 请把那个故事告诉我。

scripts.text: Who is the traveling merchant?
scripts.translation: 那个旅行商人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I liked the environment here
so I decided to stay and live.
There is no obligation here.
To me, that's as good as heaven.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
我喜欢这里的环境，
所以决定留下来生活。
这里没有束缚，
对我来说简直像天堂。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It is a very old Slate Piece.
I'm sorry but I never seen this before.
There is some kind of writing here
but I can't make it out.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
这是一块很古老的石板。
抱歉，我以前没见过它。
上面好像刻着一些字，
但我看不懂。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's a simple story.
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
故事很简单。
^0000FF一个我从未见过的受伤男人^000000
^0000FF来到我家求助。^000000
^0000FF伤好之后，他做了一个木偶^000000

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil spirits ^000000
^0000FFas a token of gratitude,^000000
^0000FFand left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
^0000FF据说那个木偶可以驱赶恶灵，^000000
^0000FF他把它当作谢礼，^000000
^0000FF随后就去了巴里奥·马希瓦加。^000000

scripts.text: He left for Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation: 他去了巴里奥·马希瓦加？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
According to what I've heard
that's correct. But the story has been
passed on from mouth to mouth for a
long time. I can't be sure.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
我听说是这样。不过这故事口耳相传了很久，
我也不能确定真假。

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
从巴里奥·马希瓦加村民那里打听，
用^0000FF马来亚^000000或^0000FF巴库暴龙^000000作关键词，
也许能查出那位旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is a lack of information
so I can't make say for sure but
I'm skeptical if he was in fact even a merchant.
Coming to a town with a
critical wound seems too suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
嗯，知道的线索太少，我没法确定。
不过我怀疑他真的是商人吗？
身受重伤还来到城镇，实在很可疑......

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
And craving a Wooden Doll
could be seen to have some kind of ritualistic meaning.
Protecting one from some evil force...
that kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
而且他执意要做一个木偶，
听起来像是有什么仪式用途，
比如用来抵御邪恶力量......

scripts.text:
Identity of the traveling merchant...
Looks like there is one more
mystery to be solved.
I suppose it will all come to light
soon enough.
scripts.translation:
旅行商人的身份......
看来还有一个谜团等着解开。
我想很快就会水落石出。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I will tell you again slowly
the story that has been passed on.
Listen carefully and repeat...
no, I mean, you don't have repeat it.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
我再慢慢讲一遍这个流传下来的故事。
仔细听，然后复述一遍......
不，我是说，不用复述。

scripts.text:
[Orally Transmitted Story]
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, as a token of gratitude, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil sprits.^000000
^0000FFThen he left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[口述故事]
^0000FF一个我从未见过的受伤男人^000000
^0000FF来到我家求助。^000000
^0000FF伤好之后，为表谢意，他做了一个木偶，^000000
^0000FF据说那个木偶可以驱赶恶灵。^000000
^0000FF之后他就去了巴里奥·马希瓦加。^000000

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
从巴里奥·马希瓦加村民那里打听，
用^0000FF马来亚^000000或^0000FF巴库暴龙^000000作关键词，
也许能查出那位旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Have you been to
Port Malaya?
I am curious to know
what is going on there
but I can't travel because there are monsters everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
你去过马来港吗？
我很想知道那里发生了什么，
可周围到处都是魔物，我没法过去。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Wooden Doll?
There is a tale related to that,
but you didn't come all the way
just to hear some folktale right?
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
木偶？
这倒是有个相关的故事，
不过你不会大老远跑来就为了听民间故事吧？

scripts.text: I just came here to take a break.
scripts.translation: 我只是来歇歇脚。

scripts.text: Tell me the tale.
scripts.translation: 把故事讲给我听。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a lot of free time on your hands!
I'm no travel agent
so go bother someone else!
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
你可真闲！
我又不是导游，
去找别人问吧！

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's baloney
so I don't really remember the details.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
都是胡说八道，
我记不太清细节了。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
to the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事摘要]
很久以前，5名剑士
与魔物巴库暴龙交战。
四人战死，另一人重创了魔物，
自己也因此
身负重伤，腿部伤势尤为严重。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事摘要]
逃离战场后，巴库暴龙变成人形，
暗中追踪那名剑士。
剑士做了一个木偶，
用来阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
This is the end of story.
Without any conclusion...
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
故事就这样结束了。
没有任何结局......

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I heard there is a record that the swordsman left
but I don't understand why
he would leave it here in such a distant place
here instead of Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
我听说那名剑士留下了一份记录，
但不明白他为何要把记录留在
这么偏远的地方，
而不是留在马来港。

scripts.text: I wish to see the record.
scripts.translation: 我想看看那份记录。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The record is engraved on the stone ahead.
However, the stone is so badly
damaged and some pieces fell out that
it will be hard to make the words out.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
记录刻在前面那块石头上。
不过石头损毁严重，
有些碎片已经脱落，
上面的字很难辨认。

scripts.text: Investigate the stone ahead.
scripts.translation: 调查前面的石头

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The stone ahead holds a record that
a swordsman from a long time ago left.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
前面的石头上刻着
一名古代剑士留下的记录。

scripts.text: Where did this swordsman go after?
scripts.translation: 那名剑士后来去了哪里？

scripts.text: Tell me the tale again.
scripts.translation: 再给我讲讲那个故事。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is no story after that so
I guess nobody would know what happened.
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
嗯，故事到这里就没了，
我想没人知道后来发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事摘要]
很久以前，5名剑士
与魔物巴库暴龙交战。
四人战死，另一人重创了魔物，
自己也因此
身负重伤，腿部伤势尤为严重。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事摘要]
逃离战场后，巴库暴龙变成人形，
暗中追踪那名剑士。
剑士做了一个木偶，
用来阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I suppose you wish to hear the story again right?
No problem! I can tell this story forever!
scripts.translation:
[马来移民]
你是想再听一遍故事吧？
没问题！我可以一直讲下去！

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事摘要]
很久以前，5名剑士
与魔物巴库暴龙交战。
四人战死，另一人重创了魔物，
自己也因此
身负重伤，腿部伤势尤为严重。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事摘要]
逃离战场后，巴库暴龙变成人形，
暗中追踪那名剑士。
剑士做了一个木偶，
用来阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
The damage is so severe
that the record is unidentifiable.
When inserting the Slate Piece
to a hole on the wall, it fits perfectly like a piece of puzzle.
The letters are not clear but you can still read it.
scripts.translation:
记录损毁得太严重，已经难以辨认。
你把石板碎片嵌进墙上的缺口，
严丝合缝，仿佛拼图一般。
字迹虽然模糊，还是勉强能读出来。

scripts.text:
Here is the record left by a swordsman
from a hundred years ago.
scripts.translation: 这是百年前一名剑士留下的记录。

scripts.text: I don't need to read it.
scripts.translation: 我不用读。

scripts.text: Read the record again.
scripts.translation: 再读一遍记录。

scripts.text:
I remember the story clearly.
Let's tell the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000 in Malaya
about what I discovered.
scripts.translation:
我已经清楚记住故事了。
去马来港把发现告诉^0000FF古老传说的讲述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
After fighting with Bakonawa, I sustained a critical wound
and came to this place.
Only thing I can do is
Place the Wooden Doll in one place
the monster would come.
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
在与巴库暴龙交战后，我身负重伤，
来到这个地方。
我唯一能做的，
就是把木偶放在
魔物可能出现的地方。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
^0000FFSometimes transforming into a child, or even a old lady,^000000
I know that ^0000FFBakonawa^000000has been
chasing after me in secret to kill me.
Because of that critical injury the monster * sustained,
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
^0000FF它有时会变成孩子，甚至老妇人的模样，^000000
我知道^0000FF巴库暴龙^000000一直在暗中
追踪我，想要杀死我。
因为魔物受了致命伤，

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
** it will need nearly a hundred years
for Bakonawa to absorb the power of the moon
to fully recover its power.
Beware of the day the moon disappears.
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
**巴库暴龙需要将近一百年
吸收月亮的力量，
才能完全恢复。
当心月亮消失的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
The day will come when Bakonawa
will run amuck.
But it will take nearly a hundred years to fully recover its power.
There will always be someone better than me
to defeat the vile creature.
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
巴库暴龙肆虐的日子终将到来。
但它需要近百年才能完全恢复力量。
总会有比我更强的人
打倒这只邪恶的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
I will place my trust in the one that will replace me ages from now...
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
我愿意相信，许多年后会有人接替我......

scripts.text:
How could this be...
Lie told by Bakonawa when it turned into an old lady
in order to take revenge on the swordsman
turned into a legend after all these years.
scripts.translation:
怎么会这样......
巴库暴龙为了向剑士复仇，
化作老妇人编造了谎言。
这么多年过去，那谎言竟成了传说。

scripts.text:
I found out that Bakonawa
is nothing but a blood thirsty monster.
I must tell what I know to the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
in Malaya.
scripts.translation:
我发现巴库暴龙
不过是嗜血的魔物。
我得去马来港，把这一切告诉
^0000FF古老传说的讲述者^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Grandpa believes
Bakonawa can
turn good.
Do you think it's possible?
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
爷爷相信
巴库暴龙能够变好。
你觉得可能吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
^FF0000Slate Piece^000000?
Why would you need something
that is barely recognizable?
I'll give it to you if you want.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
^FF0000石板碎片^000000？
这东西都破成这样了，几乎认不出来，
你要它做什么？
你想要的话就拿去吧。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然拿到了石板碎片，
现在就去见^FF0000古老传说的讲述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Please take this Slate Piece
and deliver it to my grandpa.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
请收下这块石板碎片，
替我交给爷爷。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然拿到了石板碎片，
现在就去见^FF0000古老传说的讲述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Because of Bakonawa,
the village is always unpeaceful.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
巴库暴龙害得村子一直不得安宁。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Man]
Calm Bakonawa?
Do you know how many people have been
sacrificed by Bakonawa?
I will fight on my own if I have to!
scripts.translation:
[愤怒的男人]
安抚巴库暴龙？
你知道有多少人死在它手里吗？
必要的话，我会独自去战斗！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Calm Little Girl]
It is too dangerous to fight against
Bakonawa. There is a chance
it will get more angry and put children and
elders in danger.
scripts.translation:
[冷静的小女孩]
和巴库暴龙战斗太危险了。
它可能会变得更加愤怒，
让孩子和老人陷入险境。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Boy]
I lost my father and my friend
to that Bakonawa.
I will surely revenge them!
scripts.translation:
[愤怒的男孩]
我的父亲和朋友都被巴库暴龙害死了。
我一定要替他们报仇！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品过多，无法开始对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm desperate for a helping hand
but you look
too weak and fragile.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我急需有人帮忙，
可你看起来
太弱不禁风了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please come back when
you grow strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
等你变得足够强，
能与梦魇匹敌时，
再回来吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm don't know what's the right decision.
To fight against Bakonawa,
or calm it by offering it a sacrificial gift.
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我不知道该怎么做才好。
是与巴库暴龙战斗，
还是献上祭品安抚它？
最近被巴库暴龙伤害的人越来越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The legend was all a lie?
It seems all the villagers up until now
were manipulated by that vile monster.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
传说竟然全是谎言？
看来这么多年来，村民们
一直被那只邪恶的魔物蒙骗了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
最近被巴库暴龙伤害的人越来越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
There are some missing villagers
but I can't find out if
they are simply missing or if they have been
killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
有些村民失踪了，
但我无法查明他们只是走失，
还是已经被巴库暴龙杀害。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I heard that the belongings of the missing people
are being found at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
Please go there to find ^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
and give them to the families of
the missing people
in whatever amount they want.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我听说失踪者的遗物出现在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原。
请去那里找找^0000FF失物^000000，
再按失踪者家属的要求，把相应数量的物品交给他们。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
are said to be carried by
^FF0000Tiyanak^000000 that roams Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
^0000FF失物^000000据说被在巴里奥·马希瓦加游荡的
^FF0000恶魔婴儿^000000带走了。

scripts.text: Do it yourself.
scripts.translation: 你自己去吧。

scripts.text: I'm on my way.
scripts.translation: 我这就去。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
You give me a lot to think about.
Leave the village at once.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
你让我很失望。
马上离开村子。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Let's start then. First,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and take them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
那就开始吧。首先，
从恶魔婴儿那里找回两件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交给^0000FF失踪者的父亲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
From Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从游荡在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原的恶魔婴儿那里，
找回两件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交给^0000FF失踪者的父亲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve Seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从恶魔婴儿那里找回七件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交给^0000FF失踪者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从恶魔婴儿那里找回三件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交给^0000FF失踪者的儿子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从恶魔婴儿那里找回五件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交给^0000FF失踪者的母亲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
So it's clear that all the missing people
have been killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
看来所有失踪的人
都被巴库暴龙杀害了。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
Kill Bakonawa!
Let's get rid of the monster ourselves!
scripts.translation:
[村民们]
杀了巴库暴龙！
我们自己动手消灭那只魔物！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It seems we would no longer be able to
hold rituals to calm Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
看来我们再也没法
举行仪式安抚巴库暴龙了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
年轻的占卜师说月亮的能量似乎有些异常，
她正在找你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
年轻的占卜师说月亮的能量似乎有些异常，
她正在找你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I know that terrible things happened
long time ago when the moon disappeared.
I hope the moon recovers its strength
with your devoted effort.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我知道很久以前月亮消失时，
发生过可怕的事情。
希望在你的努力下，
月亮能恢复力量。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I will tell the
Young Fortune Teller to help you.
But before that, there is
something you must do immediately.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我会让年轻的占卜师来帮你。
不过，在那之前，
有件事你必须立刻去办。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We never know when Bakonawa will attack
the village so we must set traps near the village
entrance and near the cave.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我们不知道巴库暴龙何时会袭击村庄，
所以得在村口和洞穴附近设置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I would be grateful if you help us.
I have dispatched workers
near where traps will be set up,
so you just have to visit about 5 places.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
如果你能帮忙，我会非常感激。
我已经派工人到陷阱设置点附近，
你只要去大约五个地方看看就行。

scripts.text: Sounds like too much work.
scripts.translation: 听起来太麻烦了。

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
This operation means life and death to us
yet you refuse it easily as if
it was some kind of a chore...
scripts.translation:
[村长]
这事关我们的生死存亡，
你却把它当成琐事，轻易就拒绝了......

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
What a hero!
scripts.translation:
[村长]
真是个英雄！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第一个陷阱会设在靠近村口的
巴里奥·马希瓦加平原。^0000FF粗声工人^000000会在那里等你，他会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第一个陷阱会设在靠近村口的
巴里奥·马希瓦加平原。^0000FF粗声工人^000000会在那里等你，他会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The second trap will be set up
near a place where it connects from
Baryo Mahiwaga Field to Bakonawa Lake.
^0000FFGrumpy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第二个陷阱会设在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原通往巴库纳瓦湖的路口附近。
^0000FF暴躁工人^000000会在那里等你，他会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The third trap will be set up
near Bakonawa Lake Entrance.
^0000FFCowardly Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第三个陷阱会设在巴库纳瓦湖入口附近。
^0000FF胆小工人^000000会在那里等你，他会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fourth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake as well.
^0000FFGloomy Worker^000000 will be waiting for you.
He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第四个陷阱也会设在巴库纳瓦湖入口附近。
^0000FF忧郁工人^000000会在那里等你，他会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fifth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake too.
^0000FFSentimental Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第五个陷阱同样会设在巴库纳瓦湖入口附近。
^0000FF多愁善感的工人^000000会在那里等你，他会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It looks like the traps are all set up.
We just finished our village meeting on
what to do about Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
看来陷阱都设置好了。
我们刚结束关于如何应对巴库暴龙的村民会议。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We have concluded that
we will fight against Bakonawa.
Please help us by
attacking his lair.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我们已经决定与巴库暴龙战斗。
请帮帮我们，去袭击它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Would you visit ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
when you have a chance?
I think you would be able to help him.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
有空的话，请去拜访^0000FF古老传说的讲述者^000000。
我想你能帮上他的忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
请为了无数受害者，
打倒巴库暴龙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Thank you.
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
谢谢你。
请为了无数受害者，
打倒巴库暴龙。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
Please find our
child.
Bakonawa would have not harmed our child.
He must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
请帮忙找找我们的孩子。
巴库暴龙不会伤害我们的孩子。
他一定就在附近某处。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
You are looking for two of his ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000?
Are you confident that
he already died?
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
你要找他两件^FF0000失物^000000？
你确定他已经死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
This... is our child's ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
for sure.
The monster got to him after all....
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
这......肯定是我们孩子的^FF0000失物^000000。
终究还是被那只魔物抓走了......

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Let's retrieve them from Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子强忍泪水，已经说不下去了。
我们继续寻找其他失踪者的遗物吧。
从巴里奥·马希瓦加平原游荡的恶魔婴儿那里找回七件^FF0000失物^000000，
交给^0000FF失踪者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
我的孩子......我可怜的孩子......

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子强忍泪水，已经说不下去了。
我们继续寻找其他失踪者的遗物吧。
从恶魔婴儿那里找回七件^FF0000失物^000000，
交给^0000FF失踪者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
我的孩子......我可怜的孩子......

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Please find
my friend.
We were playing ball together
and suddenly my friend disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
请帮我找找我的朋友。
我们本来在一起玩球，
他突然就不见了。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
I'm sure he is alive and well
somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
我相信他一定还活着，
就在某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
You are looking for seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend?
My friend is not dead!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
你要找我朋友的七件^FF0000失物^000000？
我朋友没有死！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
These are marbles and toys I gave him...
These are clearly ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend... Where is my friend?
Bring him here, bring him here now!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
这些弹珠和玩具都是我送给他的......
这些肯定是我朋友的^FF0000失物^000000......他在哪儿？
把他带回来，现在就把他带回来！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Bring back my friend!
Bring back my friend now!
My friend is alive,
It's all a lie, sob~
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
把我朋友还回来！
现在就把他带回来！
我朋友还活着，
这都是骗人的，呜......

scripts.text:
Leaving behind the crying boy,
let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000.
scripts.translation:
留下哭泣的男孩，
继续寻找其他失踪者的遗物吧。
从恶魔婴儿那里找回三件^FF0000失物^000000，
交给^0000FF失踪者的儿子^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Bakonawa has hurt my father?
I can't believe this.
Please find my father!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
巴库暴龙伤害了我父亲？
我不敢相信。
求你帮我找到父亲！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
You are looking for three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my father? Why lost belongings and not my father?
No, that can't be it. He is alive somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
你要找我父亲的三件^FF0000失物^000000？为什么找的是遗物，不是我父亲？
不，不可能。他一定还活着！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
These are clearly his clothes and shoes...
These are ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my father.
Oh dear lord... father!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
这些明明是他的衣服和鞋子......
这是我父亲的^FF0000失物^000000。
天啊......父亲！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Why did such a thing happen....
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
为什么会发生这种事......

scripts.text:
Man crying in agony.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子悲痛欲绝。
继续寻找其他失踪者的遗物吧。
从恶魔婴儿那里找回五件^FF0000失物^000000，
交给^0000FF失踪者的母亲^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Please find my child.
I sent her out to do a chore
and she still isn't back.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
求你帮我找找孩子。
我让她出门办点事，
她到现在还没回来。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
You are looking for five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
What does this mean?
Are you saying my child is dead?
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
你要找我孩子的五件^FF0000失物^000000？
这是什么意思？
你是说我的孩子死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
This is my child's hair comb.
Why do you have five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
Why...? She's... dead?
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
这是我孩子的梳子。
为什么你会拿着她的五件^FF0000失物^000000？
为什么......她......死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
No wait... I think I hear her voice.
She's going to be home soon. I should go home now.
I should prepare a dinner for her. She must be starving.
Ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
不，等等......我好像听见她的声音了。
她很快就回家了。我也该回家了。
得给她准备晚饭，她一定饿坏了。
哈哈......

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已经精神失常的母亲......
既然失踪者的线索都查过了，
我该回去向村长报告。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Ha ha ha... I can hear my child's voice,
just listen closely.
Can't you hear her calling her mother?
Ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
哈哈哈......我听得见孩子的声音，
你仔细听听。
难道没听见她在叫妈妈吗？
哈哈哈......

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已经精神失常的母亲......
既然失踪者的线索都查过了，
我该回去向村长报告。

scripts.text: A mother that has gone mad...
scripts.translation: 一位已经精神失常的母亲......

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品过多，无法开始对话。 -

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims,
is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
月亮的能量变弱了。
魔物变多、受害者增加，
都是因为这个。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak for a couple of days.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims, is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
这几天月亮的能量一直在减弱。
魔物变多、受害者增加，
都是因为这个。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I'm trying to hold a ritual
that will restore the moon's energy by sacrificing monsters' blood,
so I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
我正打算举行仪式，献上魔物之血来恢复月亮的能量。
所以需要你去巴里奥·马希瓦加平原猎杀15只^FF0000邪魔马^000000。

scripts.text: It's none of my business.
scripts.translation: 这不关我的事。

scripts.text: You can count on me.
scripts.translation: 交给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
You are so selfish!
During the ritual,
I will pray for your bad luck too.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
你真自私！
仪式期间，我也会祈祷让你倒霉。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
快点。
要是月亮完全消失，
就会酿成大灾难。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
It looks like you took care of ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
well enough.
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
看来你已经把^FF0000邪魔马^000000处理得差不多了。
我想现在可以开始仪式了。
我们还需要一些东西，去找村长帮忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
去巴里奥·马希瓦加平原猎杀15只^FF0000邪魔马^000000。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
快点。
要是月亮完全消失，
就会酿成大灾难。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
我想现在可以开始仪式了。
我们还需要一些东西，去找村长帮忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
On the day when the moon fully disappears,
the dragon will attack the village.
No one will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[年轻占卜师]
月亮完全消失的那天，
恶龙就会袭击村庄。
到时候谁也逃不掉。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
村长让我在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The trap will be set right in front.
Walk forward a little.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
陷阱就设在前面。
再往前走几步。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
去巴里奥·马希瓦加平原通往巴库纳瓦湖的路口附近，找暴躁工人。
和他一起把陷阱设好。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Are you trying to advertise that
there is a trap here? Step aside.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
你是在故意告诉大家这里有陷阱吗？让开。

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Using the tools like this
bang bang bang!
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
像这样用工具——
砰砰砰！

scripts.text: bang bang bang!
scripts.translation: 砰砰砰！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
去巴里奥·马希瓦加平原通往巴库纳瓦湖的路口附近，找暴躁工人。
和他一起把陷阱设好。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 这里已经布置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
This trap is not meant to capture you,
so move.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
这陷阱又不是用来抓你的，
快让开。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go there to him.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
去巴里奥·马希瓦加平原通往巴库纳瓦湖的路口附近找暴躁工人。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Sooo boring!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
村长叫我在这里等你。
无聊死了！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
A hole needs to be dug up in front of here?
I have to dig too?
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
要在前面挖个坑？
我也得挖？
谁说的？

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
去巴库纳瓦湖入口附近找胆小工人。
快点，动起来！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I set up the trap
and you are advertising that it's here.
Scram!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
陷阱是我设的，
你却站在这儿告诉大家陷阱的位置。
滚开！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I really don't like it here!
...
With this pickax,
dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
我真讨厌这里！
......
拿这把镐子，
挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
去巴库纳瓦湖入口附近找胆小工人。
快点，动起来！

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 这里已经布置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Are you trying to test
with your body if the trap works?
Move aside!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
你是想亲自试试陷阱灵不灵吗？
快让开！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
去巴库纳瓦湖入口附近找胆小工人。
快点，动起来！

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Why me? I have a bad feeling about this....
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
村长叫我在这里等你。
为什么偏偏是我？我总觉得要出事......

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
set up a trap in front of here?
Village Chief said I have to help too?
Can you please do it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
要在前面布置陷阱？
村长说我也得帮忙？
你能不能自己弄好？

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
Go! You scare me.
You look like you are going to beat me up.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
往上走就能找到忧郁工人。
快去！你让我害怕，
看起来像是要揍我似的。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go away!
What if Bakonawa
appears because of you?
I'm scared to death!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
走开！
你在这里的话，巴库纳瓦说不定会出现！
我快吓死了！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
There is nothing weird
buried here right?
...
Using the shovel, dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
这里没埋什么奇怪的东西吧？
......
用铲子挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
往上走就能找到忧郁工人。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 这里已经布置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Step aside immediately!
Bakonawa might find out this is a trap
and come for us.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
马上让开！
巴库纳瓦可能会发现这是陷阱，然后来找我们算账。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
往上走就能找到忧郁工人。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
He must want me to do something.
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
村长叫我在这里等你。
他肯定有事要我做。
唉......

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
set up a trap on the left side?
I don't think it will be much use...
Whew, I should've moved away or something...
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
要在左边设陷阱？
我觉得没什么用......
唉，我真该早点搬走......

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
We are all gonna die anyway by Bakonawa.
This is pointless.
Just go up the path and you will find
Sentimental Worker.
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
反正我们迟早都会被巴库纳瓦杀掉。
做这些有什么意义？
沿着路往上走，去找多愁善感工人吧。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Bakonawa is going to attack us anyway.
What pointless work...
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
反正巴库纳瓦都会来袭击我们。
真是白费力气......

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Just catch this net,
throw throw!
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
拿着这张网，
扔、扔、扔！

scripts.text: throw throw!
scripts.translation: 扔、扔、扔！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Just go up the path and you will find
Sentimental Worker.
Though I doubt it will be much help.
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
沿着路往上走就能找到多愁善感工人。
不过我觉得他也帮不上什么忙。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 这里已经布置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
The trap is meaningless.
See? It doesn't even work.
scripts.translation:
[忧郁的工人]
这陷阱根本没用。
看吧，完全不起作用。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
Is there a some kind of surprise event?
My heart is beating faster~
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
村长叫我在这里等你。
是要办什么惊喜活动吗？
我的心跳得好快~

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Wow! So we are going to work together
to set up a trap behind this place?
This is sooo cool!
This is the coolest thing in the world!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
哇！我们要一起在这里后面设陷阱吗？
太酷了！
这简直是世界上最酷的事！

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Now that the trap is set,
Are we going to report back to Village Chief?
Oh what fun!
It sounds so exiting!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
陷阱设好了，
接下来要回去向村长报告吗？
太有趣了！
听起来真让人兴奋！

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
More I think about it, more exited I get.
I'm secretly guarding the trap!
I want to hear out loud.
I have a trap in front of me! Ha ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
越想我就越兴奋。
我正在偷偷看守陷阱呢！
真想大声喊出来：
我面前有个陷阱！哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Wow! This really is a perfect place
to set up a trap.
I'm going to throw the rope!
Here goes the rope!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
哇！这里真是设陷阱的绝佳地点。
我要把绳子扔出去了！
绳子出发！

scripts.text: Here goes the rope!
scripts.translation: 绳子出发！

scripts.text:
The trap is now set.
Let's go to the Village Chief
now that the trap is set.
scripts.translation:
陷阱布置好了。
既然已经设好陷阱，
我们去找村长吧。

scripts.text: The trap is set here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经设在这里了。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Try out the trap first!
I'm so curious
what would happen!
It's going to be so much fun!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
先试试陷阱吧！
我真想知道会发生什么！
一定很好玩！

scripts.text: Seafood and Black Bean Sauce Noodle!
scripts.translation: 海鲜黑豆酱面！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Just boldly tell me
what is it that you want!
scripts.translation:
[布里凯·施梅]
痛痛快快地告诉我，
你到底想要什么！

scripts.text: Reset all quests
scripts.translation: 重置所有任务

scripts.text: Just before the end of first quest
scripts.translation: 第一个任务结束前

scripts.text: Reset secondary quest
scripts.translation: 重置支线任务

scripts.text: Distribution of lost belongings
scripts.translation: 分发失物

scripts.text: Just after hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎之后

scripts.text: Here you go!
scripts.translation: 给你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凯·施梅]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!

给你！

[布里凯·施梅]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凯·施梅]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman?
I think you should search for something else.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
护符？
我觉得你该找找别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman and a person?
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
护符和一个人？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I did see the talisman but I didn't go near it because I got a bad feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
我确实看见过那枚护符，不过总觉得不太对劲，就没敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the village?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
哦！说到护符，那位老妇人不是在村子周围放了几枚吗？她应该很了解。去问问她比较好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the hospital?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
哦！说到护符，那位老妇人不是在医院周围放了几枚吗？她应该很了解。去问问她比较好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A shaman... Best if we met her.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
一位萨满......最好能亲自见见她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
You must have met her.
I feel something strong...
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
哦！你已经见过她了吧？
我能感觉到一股强大的力量......

scripts.text: Tell her about the talisman.
scripts.translation: 告诉她护符的事

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
好！我有个主意。
把这枚护符贴到我们在二楼门上看到的那枚上面，怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
也许这样就能挡住它散发出的邪气。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
好！我有个主意。
把这枚护符贴到我们在二楼门上看到的那枚上面，怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[护士拉斯]
也许这样就能挡住它散发出的邪气。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
*Sigh*...
I thought it strange when you were standing behind me....
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
*叹气*......
刚才你站在我身后时，我就觉得不对劲......

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I didn't think you'd do something like this.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
没想到你会做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
We were just about to enter Bangungot's room, before we were thrown out...
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我们本来正要进般滚勾特的房间，结果却被赶了出来......

scripts.text: Bangungot?
scripts.translation: 般滚勾特？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne?
scripts.translation: 护士梅恩？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne
scripts.translation: 护士梅恩

scripts.text: Bangungot
scripts.translation: 般滚勾特

scripts.text: Enter the hospital.
scripts.translation: 进入医院

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmm...

- Wait !! -
- You have too many items. -
- Cannot receive item. -
- Please lighten your bag -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品栏已满。 -
- 无法接收物品。 -
- 请整理背包， -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You are carrying too many items. -
- Cannot receive item. -
- Please lighten your bag -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你携带的物品过多。 -
- 无法接收物品。 -
- 请整理背包， -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Tsk...

[Nurse Maenne]
It's a vicious monster roaming this hospital.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
有只凶恶的魔物在这家医院里游荡。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmmm...
It's not exactly a monster....
More like a curse or disease...
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
嗯......
严格来说，它不算魔物......
更像是诅咒，或某种疾病......

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
There's a story saying that it used to be a wood fairy.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
有个传说说，它以前是森林妖精。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Anyway, it doesnt change the fact that she killed the patients of this hospital and turned them into monsters.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
不过，无论如何，她杀害了这家医院的病人，还把他们变成了魔物，这一点不会改变。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Me?
As you can see, I'm the new nurse here.
I'm a nurse who specializes in 'this' kind of work, instead of looking after patients.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我？
如你所见，我是这里的新护士。
我不负责照顾病人，而是专门处理“这类”事情。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Oh!
The Bangungot pretended to be me?
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
哦！
般滚勾特假扮成我了？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Seeing how much it rattled you.
It's a rather smart one.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
看你被吓成这样，就知道它还挺聪明的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Simply said, I cure unnatural phenomenon around hospitals.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
简单来说，我负责处理医院周围发生的超自然现象。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Many things happen in the world.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
世上总会发生各种各样的事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
She may have rooted here deeper than I thought.
I can still feel her presence.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
她在这里扎根的程度比我想象的还深。
我现在仍能感觉到她的存在。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
What you killed was a part of her...
But, it was a big help since you confused and damaged her at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你杀死的只是她的一部分......
不过这帮了大忙，你既扰乱了她，也伤到了她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It makes things a lot easier.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
这样事情就好办多了。
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It would've been easier if she was apart from her body, but now that she returned to her room, this is going to be a little tricky.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
如果她离开了自己的身体，事情会容易得多。可现在她已经回到房间，处理起来就有些棘手了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Of course, don't you dare walk away from this, since you disturbed my job and led her to her room.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你可别想就这么走掉。你打扰了我的工作，还把她引回房间，这事得由你负责。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
If you make it to the 2nd floor door, I'll open a small door to her room for you.
After that, she's all yours.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你只要到二楼的门口，我就会替你打开一扇通往她房间的小门。
之后就交给你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
People of this town are too cautious of outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
镇上的人对外来者都很戒备。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'm sure they have their reasons, but I wish they'd tell me how to get closer...
scripts.translation:
[护士]
我知道他们一定有自己的理由，但真希望他们能告诉我，该怎么和大家熟络起来......

scripts.text:
There's a nurse outside the hospital holding a large bag.
I don't think I can help her.
scripts.translation:
医院外有位护士提着一个大袋子。
我觉得自己帮不上她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Hey, hold on.
Are you planning on going inside?
scripts.translation:
[护士]
喂，等一下。
你打算进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Oh~
I'm so glad!
I was literally waiting all day for someone to some by.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
哦~
太好了！
我等了一整天，就盼着有人路过呢。

scripts.text: About the hospital
scripts.translation: 关于医院

scripts.text: Reason for stalling me
scripts.translation: 你为什么拦着我？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 不理她

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
This hospital is the only one in town.
And it's going to be my new job.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
这家医院是镇上唯一的一家。
而且我马上就要在这里上班了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I heard it was just built, but it seems so creepy....
scripts.translation:
[护士]
听说医院才刚建好，可看起来阴森森的......

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was surprised when I got here too.
It says 'closed' all around it!
scripts.translation:
